summary: ceil returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to a number.
documentation: ceil returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to a number. For a positive quotient, it is useful when any remainder requires another whole resource unit.
returns: The least integer not smaller than the input.
caution: For negative values, ceiling moves toward positive infinity, not away from zero. Define valid business inputs before dividing.
scenarios: Determine buses needed for a group.
Allocate pages for an already counted result set.
Estimate containers when partially filled containers still count.
title: Reserve enough vans
problem: Input has integer passengers >= 0 and seats > 0. Return the number of vans needed when each van holds at most seats passengers. A partial van counts as one; zero passengers need zero vans.
goal: Use Math.ceil() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
